purpose: Use the user's existing RTX 5080 server to establish a portable real executor, bounded real PPO engineering pilot and qualified short material tasks before proposing paid cloud-scale learning. This contract is a plan, not executed evidence.
implementation_status: R12 entrypoints and the targeted runtime/policy changes must be implemented before execution; this document does not claim the R11 scripts already satisfy R12.

history.new_scope_rule: R12 is an explicitly planned local readiness phase. Do not resume the paused cloud campaign or refresh its budget by renaming it.

configuration_reuse.overrides: R12 owns local paths, run identity, explicit engineering-pilot candidate, active streams, pilot target/resume/truncation/accounting, local scope, budget and cloud-readiness decision. Keep R11 physical and formal task semantics unless explicitly restated here.

apply gait transition before numerical settings and read back actual values

configuration_reuse.assets_rule: Recover only needed source/build/model/weight assets for execution and selected evidence. Do not reconstruct all 21 historical controller builds or download all 77 assets.
configuration_reuse.identity_rule: Resolve project/interpreter/build/assets/binary paths. Record actual source/patch/compiler/native libraries/models/parameters/binary/worker identity before physics. Local rebuild is a new identity and does not inherit cloud qualification.

plant_invariants.history_rule: World-fixed shared columns recover when unloaded. Reset only between independent episodes/acquisition sessions, never at PPO updates, laps or file boundaries.
plant_invariants.prohibited: softening truth to pass, clipping material strain/force, injecting planned GRF, relaxing task/physical limits, replacing the training plant or controller

local_execution.worker_rule: Choose and record one value from actual host resources before first physics; use the same resolved value for final fixed E30/E60, rigid regression and final pilot. If parallel pilots do not fit, run sequentially without changing worker identity. Any subsequent worker change creates a new execution identity and requires its own qualification.
local_execution.same_semantics_performance_scope: Reduce redundant RPC/FK/logging and batch material arithmetic/reuse constants without changing the true .2ms material integration, .2ms physics,2ms action holding, persistent unloaded recovery or fair information. No fast substitute controller/plant.
local_execution.r12_entrypoint_rule: Explicitly adapt run/stage/contract/output/deadline and candidate-vs-frozen paths; never start paused R11 as a shortcut.
local_execution.first_real_task: Predeclared local fixed nominal material E30; a valid failed record may establish pilot eligibility but not formal qualification.
local_execution.environment_rule: Inspect actual versions and locked dependency compatibility. Limit necessary adjustments to the user's existing kaiwen-learn environment; do not alter base/other environments/system libraries/global shell settings or solve a concrete conflict by upgrading the entire stack.

controller_development.initial_candidate: ported S5-r21 with actual inherited fixes
controller_development.fixed_freeze_rule: Same actual execution identity first passes independent nominal material E30 then E60 with full observation. Retain the first qualifying identity and one original nominal rigid60 regression; no result/version mixing.

next_mechanism_hypothesis.name: actual_support_handoff_within_existing_horizon
next_mechanism_hypothesis.condition: Use retained r20/r21 and first local evidence to confirm support-handoff hypothesis; if contradicted, document the earliest mismatch before choosing one evidence-backed alternative.
next_mechanism_hypothesis.change_together: Scale clearance and both quintic times; do not merely change duty while leaving hardcoded0.20s descent. Preserve the remaining r21 C/objective/numerical configuration for this single mechanism hypothesis.
required_evidence: actual foot vertical speed and clearance
matching candidate plan and causal anchors
next_mechanism_hypothesis.decision: If prediction already chooses loss of support, address objective/feasibility. If prediction is supportive and truth differs, address specific contact/execution/derivative mismatch. Nominal gait flags alone do not demonstrate support.

controller_development.stop_rule: No blind rerun of identical deterministic failure. After two successive evidence batches stop the current branch only if both no relevant improvement and no new testable mechanism hold. End work at actual delivery, concrete unresolved blocker or common deadline; do not invent a global12/61-start cap.

candidate_start_requirements: locked actual local candidate identity and resolved parameters
correct original initialization and initial stand
cap actually influences permitted translation reference
real TM02 interaction and material loading
correct causal clocks, original physical/task failure semantics and no truth-state leakage
joint_learning.start_priority: Once eligible, perform the early real pilot before another open-ended sequence of control variants. A failed E30 is not by itself a pilot prohibition.
joint_learning.actor_action: single speed cap [.18,.25] m/s; .215+.035*sample.action, where existing sample.action is already tanh(raw); retain raw action/log_prob
joint_learning.shared_observation: Retain R9 public proprioception/task phase/goals/strip and preceding1s at20Hz. Same schema across all training and formal30/60/300/600/optional durations: old finite-task flag and remaining-time channels always zero. Evaluator enforces the actual deadlines/criteria. No true material q/e.
joint_learning.pann: Frozen B_random1000--ideal seed0 and original normalization; independent causal LearnedColumns world state, no true material q/e input
joint_learning.pann_features: Preserve R9 2 ms causal observer, latest completed plan t+.20 s four footprints, private zero-load recovery at2/200/500 ms and12 area-weighted signed depressions. Shared public query positions/masks; RAW prediction channels zero. Match world keys, not array row indices; queries do not alter truth or observer.

ppo.library: tianshou==0.5.1; use existing audited PPOPolicy.learn adapter

joint_learning.continuing_route: Endless0->3->0m circuits during current60/300/600s acquisition session; original2s stable endpoint holds and real turns. Lap completion is not session termination. No per-lap state reset or parking after a target number of laps.
joint_learning.primary_checkpoint_rule: When both finish,512 each. Otherwise retain each actual collected/updated/tail count and identify the greatest common completed256 multiple as coverage only; any stream below512 means the pilot is partial.
joint_learning.on_policy: Separate parameters, optimizer, normalizers, seeds and environment/MPC/material/observer state for each stream. Collect each256-transition fragment under its fixed behavior policy; update only that stream and then continue its state. Do not mix other seeds or stale-policy fragments to fake on-policy data. Archive frozen evaluation normalizers with checkpoints.

collect only remaining transitions to cumulative512
tail_required_fields: actual policy observation or exact normalization reconstruction
restore_protocol.interruption_rule: Without complete real successor or environment state, retain technical truncation/missing data honestly; never fabricate a final observation or seamless physical continuation.

sample_boundary_fix.external_boundary: 60s acquisition or512 total budget: bootstrap real pre-reset successor and cut GAE across reset.

joint_learning.accounting_fix: Refresh authoritative collected/updated/tail/serial/resume-generation state after update, restore and finish. Do not let pre-update collection.json or old stopped.json override the current run. A partial second stream never becomes complete by using a common lower checkpoint.
joint_learning.candidate_change_rule: Early candidate pilot and final-controller pilot are separate cohorts. Reuse once only when actual identity is unchanged. No cross-controller trajectories, optimizer or weights as final qualification; do not rerun a full pilot automatically for every intermediate variant.
joint_learning.diagnostics: Record causal observer timing, world-key/query/mask/feature exposure and policy identity/action application. Distinguish physically unvisited zero features from a disconnected observer; no truth q/e correction.
joint_learning.cohort_id_rule: Bind each pilot cohort_id to actual controller/execution identity. Early and changed final candidates use independent logs/checkpoints/optimizer/counts; unchanged identity may reuse one completed cohort once.
joint_learning.run_total_accounting: Accumulate all cohorts' actual transitions, updates, failures and costs.1024 is the two-stream target per cohort, not a cap on the whole R12. Two completed distinct candidate cohorts total2048 transitions and8 updates; preserve partial cohorts too.

reward_adaptation.base: Frozen R9 physical progress/time/indentation/slip/applied-action-change reward and weights; no reward for predicted material or assumed beneficial compaction
reward_adaptation.rate_rule: Keep original dt/60 denominators and physical normalization at all acquisition stages; no cost division by300/600. Integrate actual dt after early failure.
reward_adaptation.progress: Unwrapped signed actual translational progress divided by6m per circuit; split phase changes, include backward motion, no position-reset or phase-switch progress bonus.
reward_adaptation.events: Continuing training gives original+10 once per full circuit after home stability, then continues; no far-end or passive-standing bonus. Physical/material failure gives-10 once. All external acquisition/sample-budget truncations, including60s and cumulative512 pilot transitions, create no additional failure, intrinsic-timeout or completion reward/penalty. A true physical failure on the same transition retains terminal semantics and its original penalty; a genuinely completed circuit retains its original one-time event reward. Future300/600 acquisition boundaries obey the same external rule. Original finiteE60 single-mission termination and-5 intrinsic timeout remain evaluation/reference semantics, not continuing train60.
reward_adaptation.freeze: Same adapted reward and task semantics in both learning groups before training. No reward or hyperparameter sweep and no formal-result tuning.
reward_adaptation.interpretation: Long continuous execution is not proof of long-delay credit assignment; gamma remains.99 and the material memory time is determined by actual physics.

local_required_rigid.rule: One original nominal regression for final actual identity; no unrelated nine-condition matrix. Technical incompletion is not a pass.

evaluation.optional_local_entry: Final fixed case owns its E60; required final pilot, rigid regression and readiness evidence completed, with adequate measured budget.

stages.criteria: Reach original far3m endpoint by original arrival predicate and actually load/traverse the TM02 strip, then continue original turn/return logic. Observe full30s without original physical/material failure. No new30s turn-completion or whole-round-trip deadline; no extra far-end hold, shortened strip-avoiding route or deliberate parking.
stages.progress_reporting: Actual material loading evidence, far-arrival time, turn/return phase times, real return progress and complete physical criteria. E30 pass is short-stage capability, never an original E60 complete mission.

stages.criteria: Unchanged original single mission; observe through60s, no newly added far-end hold
stages.start_rule: Same exact case's E30 passes; independent original60s mission, never skip short qualification.
Same exact frozen case's E60 passes; run a separately declared independent300s task, without waiting for other cases.
stages.observation_rule: Complete5 circuits by270s, hold and observe through300s, require original final continuous2s stability; record all violations. A600s prefix is not this independent E300 result.

stages.start_rule: Same exact frozen case's independent E300 passes; no E60->E600 shortcut or qualification borrowed from another condition/seed.
stages.observation_rule: Complete10 circuits by540s, hold and observe through600s, require original final continuous2s stability. In-trajectory300s is only an observation and cannot replace the prerequisite independent E300.

material_traversal_evidence.scope: E30 original-route passage requirement, not a new physical failure threshold
material_traversal_evidence.geometry: Original strip x[.8,2.2], y[-.6,.6]m; original footprint-interior contact rule unchanged
material_traversal_evidence.measurement: First outbound base projection passes west-to-east within the original strip sides, with actual loaded material feet during that interval. Record entry, exit, side exit and lateral excursion. Merely touching the material and then bypassing it on rigid ground is not passage through the material strip.
material_traversal_evidence.retained: Run the independently declared full stage duration unless original physical/material failure or technical/budget interruption; do not terminate early on this coverage measurement.

evaluation.case_identity_rule: Separate common case identity from stage identity. The predeclared duration, short/original/continuous task kind, target circuits, route deadline and hold semantics are stage fields; their specified differences do not invalidate predecessor qualification. Preserve each full resolved config/hash but do not use its entire hash as the shared ladder key. Other trajectory-affecting changes requalify.
evaluation.entry_rule: Each exact case must pass its own immediate predecessor before the next stage; E30 has no earlier duration prerequisite. No nominal->yaw, seed0->seed1/2 or method substitution; no all-method barrier.
evaluation.version_rule: Trajectory-affecting controller/config/weights/normalizer changes re-establish E30 onward; retain closed version results. Pure publication/docs changes do not require reruns.
evaluation.independence: Each level is independently predeclared and run from the same case's independent initial state. No reset inside laps/updates/log chunks. Training trajectories and post-hoc prefixes do not qualify.
evaluation.freeze: Primary common checkpoints and normalizers fixed for entire evaluation trajectories; deterministic policy mean; no PPO updates during formal tests. PANN estimated states and MPC still evolve causally.
evaluation.reuse: Exactly same actual source/config/binary/checkpoint/normalizers/initial state/protocol and predeclared development qualification may populate its one formal manifest record with provenance, never double count. No retrospective R10 E30, longer-trajectory prefixes, training rollouts or stitched runs as independent stages.
evaluation.all_long_tasks: Original stability tolerances,2s holds at both endpoints and actual turns; no lap resets or stitched runs. At route completion hold until declared horizon and require final continuous2s stability; report every violation, final30s and each lap/60s segment. Failures terminate truthfully and remain in denominators. All durations are simulation time, not wall time.
evaluation.observation_consistency: Same observation schema for all training and evaluation durations, old finite-task flag/countdown always zero. Evaluator enforces E30/E60/E300/E600 criteria independently; no new actor countdown inputs.
evaluation.local_reporting: Report local predeclared cases and actual highest valid stages. Engineering pilot is a distinct evidence category and cannot populate a formal stage.

future_full_matrix.composition: FIXED3 initial states + RAW/PANN x3seeds x3initial states; each owns its full30/60/300/600 ladder

budget.technical_and_zero_step_failures: Preserve records and wall time; every actual integrated attempt counts as physical regardless of early failure/crash/missing data.
budget.reserve_rule: Estimate remaining mandatory local work from actual tasks, not the inactive84-stage matrix; preserve readiness/qualification/pilot delivery time. If targets do not fit, keep priority and report partial evidence rather than preventing every eligible early pilot.

extrapolation_only.rule: Not local measured throughput: reset/observer/compile/resource contention and different hardware can change cost. Early terminals shorten transition time and add startup costs.
extrapolation_only.sample_scope: one_candidate_two_stream_cohort; final changed identity may require a second independent cohort within the same R12 deadline

formal_learning_future.primary_checkpoint_rule: Predeclare affordable common actual updated sample count before formal evaluation; no best-seed or formal-performance checkpoint selection, label undertraining.
formal_learning_future.formal_ladder_rule: Each learned frozen checkpoint/seed/initial state establishes its own30->60->300->600 qualification. Fixed-controller passes do not qualify learned cases.

resources.solver_worker_rule: Resolve unified actual workers from local_execution and include in all final controller/pilot identities; reduce concurrency before silently changing workers.
resources.performance_claim: No assumption that5080 is faster, that GPU memory controls CPU solver throughput, or that20ms logical planning is real-time execution.
